purpose: Universal read-only terminal-mark sensitivity; neither hypothetical proceeds nor unknown stale values authorize cash or fills.

calculations.marked_equity: ending_cash plus sum exact terminal quantity times recorded terminal mark; independently reconcile recorded ending equity
calculations.modeled_exit_cost_equity: ending_cash plus sum quantity times recorded mark times (1-slippage_bps/10000) times (1-fee_bps/10000)
calculations.stale_over_24h_zero_value_equity: ending_cash plus modeled exit-cost value only for terminal parents with mark_age_seconds<=86400; other marks assigned zero solely for sensitivity

costs: Exact declared fee/slippage of each arm, not a claimed actual historical venue fee.
disclosure: These are valuation sensitivities, not executions or realizable liquidation. Pair minima, volume, book availability and listing/delisting completeness remain unverified. Missing terminal marks fail reconciliation. Negative or zero post-cost PnL cannot support a commercial profit claim.
finalist_gate: Original frozen marked-PnL and drawdown strategy-selection gate is unchanged; sensitivities are always reported separately for every completed arm.
